answer.text:
Gross profit margin = Gross profit ÷ Net sales × 100

= $494.777 million ÷ $1,409.281 million × 100  
= **35.1%** (rounded to one decimal place).

Source: Utz Brands, Inc. 10-K, accession **0001739566-25-000053**, Item 8, Financial Statements and Supplementary Data, chunk **c9f988c9-0c08-55d0-8891-c0f3e4093e75**.
